title: Irrationality of special values
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Irrationality proofs by small linear forms and by determinants. The irrationality of ζ(2) and Apéry's theorem that ζ(3) is irrational, by Beukers' integrals and an involution of the unit interval; then the complete proof that Catalan's constant G = 1 - 1/9 + 1/25 - ... is irrational: determinants of mixed moments with Chebyshev rows whose Taylor contact cancels ζ(2), lower bounds for their denominators at the prime 2 and at the odd primes by base-p digit reductions, nonvanishing at prime scales by Frobenius and a finite certificate, and an upper bound at the real place by an integral formula, bounded interpolation, Chebyshev expansions of logarithmic kernels and an exact root certificate.
prerequisites: Core course D10 (measure and integration: monotone convergence, Fubini's theorem)
Core course C50 (complex analysis: Cauchy's integral formula, maximum modulus principle)
NT-ZETA lesson on the prime number theorem (Theorem 3.1)
NT-LOC lesson on completions and the p-adic numbers

checks.exact_checks: python: the monomial integrals, the Legendre-form bounds and the involution identity for zeta(2) and zeta(3) (scratch irr_l1_checks.py); the Chebyshev rows, Taylor contact, moment recurrences, starting values 4G and pi^2/4 and the decomposition of the moments by quadrature with error below 1e-15 (cat_l2_checks.py, cat_l2_checks2.py); base-p digit reductions, the leading and central layers and the loss integral 8609/2 (cat_l4_digits.py, cat_l4_layers.py); the three 48 x 48 determinants modulo 101 with all 144 pivots (cat_l5_certificate.py); the 33 root brackets, sign-variation counts, norm terms .778415976284 and .931985203901 and the final bound -2.290939875 in exact rational arithmetic (cat_l7_certificate2.py) (8 Oct 2026)

free_sources: OpenAI, Catalan's constant is irrational (preprint, 24 Sep 2026)
